description: Add one receiptless expense or client-provided expense advance to the expense sheet after the user confirms; no server preview, it writes on call. Ordinary expenses: list_categories first; use a configured Expense Account. Advances: isClientAdvance=true + clientName reuses/creates the canonical client group, applies Cash advance received and writes a negative expense. Only client money provided before spending; never for vendor refunds, reimbursements, earned fees, retainers or generic deposits. Multiple/incomplete entries, refunds, tax/tip/per diem: Manual expense link from get_spreadsheet_url.

category.description: A configured Expense Account returned by list_categories. Do not invent a category.

clientName.description: Client name for a client advance, in ordinary language. ExpenseBot resolves the canonical Client – Name group.

isClientAdvance.description: True only when a client supplied money in advance for expenses. Requires clientName and does not require category.

merchant.description: Merchant/vendor name for an ordinary expense. Not needed for a client advance; ExpenseBot derives it from clientName.

total.description: Positive amount paid or received. ExpenseBot stores a client advance as negative.

name: add_cash_expense
